title: Grid Import and Export Cost Balance
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue (`emporia:circuit`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, and smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=dsmr:telegram
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(import_kwh) as import_kwh, sum(export_kwh) as export_kwh by _time
| eval net_cost=round(import_kwh*0.30 - export_kwh*0.10,2)
| sort - _time
description: Balances the energy you bought from the grid against what you sold back and turns it into a daily net cost using your tariff.
value: The net grid balance is what actually lands on your bill; seeing it daily connects your habits and the weather to real money.
implementation: Ingest smart-meter import/export registers; set your tariffs and schedule daily to track net cost.
visualization: Chart of daily grid import, export, and net cost.
grandmaExplanation: It works out each day whether you bought more electricity than you sold back, and what that costs.
